english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for people or things being separate in space or for considering them separately.

exampleSentences.english: The two tables need to be kept apart.

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when people or things are apart rather than together.

exampleSentences.english: These two tables need to be placed separately; don’t push them together.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢兩張枱要分開擺，唔好撈埋一齊。
